The '''Tun Wala system''' was part of the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was one of the three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of the Ktilac Regions&mdash;which were co-inhabited by the [[Ktilac]], [[Murachaun]], and [[Tocoyan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;that, under strict conditions, were open to visits by outsiders.<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[City/Legends|settlement]] [[Tun Wala]] on<ref name="As Long">"[[As Long As We Live...]]"</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda II]].<ref name="As Long" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tun Wala system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
